details: Bitcoin's price has shown slight positive movement in the last 24 hours, trading around $84,700-$84,784. However, it failed to break the $87,000 resistance level by October 3, 2026, with whale sales exceeding 30,000 BTC during a recent rally, indicating potential short-term downside risk towards $82,500. US spot Bitcoin ETFs experienced approximately $1.72 billion in outflows over five days, though some recent inflows were also noted.
title: Bitcoin Struggles at $87,000 Resistance Amid ETF Outflows

details: Blast, a previously prominent Ethereum layer-2 network, is ceasing operations as its assets have plummeted by 98%. The shutdown is attributed to costs significantly outweighing revenue, and users are strongly advised to transfer their assets back to the Ethereum mainnet promptly.
title: Ethereum Layer-2 Network Blast Shuts Down After 98% Asset Plunge

details: Ethereum's price has seen a slight decline over the past 24 hours, hovering around $2,668-$2,714. Sentiment in Ethereum derivatives has turned slightly negative over the past week, with Net Taker Volume indicating a shift towards net selling in perpetual futures contracts. Despite this, the Ethereum ecosystem saw a positive development with the launch of zkAPI on its mainnet, enabling privacy-preserving API payments via zero-knowledge proofs. The "Glamsterdam" upgrade is also scheduled for the Sepolia testnet on October 6, preparing for new gas pricing and block features on the mainnet in Q4.
title: Ethereum Derivatives Sentiment Turns Negative, Development Continues

details: SMBC Nikko, a prominent Japanese financial services company, is planning to establish a decentralized finance (DeFi) gateway in collaboration with Uniswap. This move signals increasing institutional interest and potential mainstream adoption of DeFi protocols in traditional finance.
title: Major Financial Institution Explores Japan DeFi Gateway with Uniswap

details: The Non-Fungible Token (NFT) market is currently facing a downturn, with sales volume decreasing by nearly 13% over the past day, reaching approximately $42.1 million. Adding to market concerns, a recent security breach saw a threat actor steal eight Hypurr NFTs, valued at around $400,000, by compromising wallets shortly after the collection's launch.
title: NFT Market Experiences Downturn and Security Incidents

details: Ethena (ENA) experienced a 9% price drop as a significant unlock of 3.03 billion ENA tokens was announced for October 5, 2026. This large influx of tokens into the market often leads to selling pressure as capital rotates into Bitcoin and other large-cap cryptocurrencies.
title: Ethena Faces 9% Drop Ahead of Large Token Unlock
